candidates.change_summary: Change first branch condition to require _BASE_RESERVE_ <= _BASE_TARGET_ (<= instead of <), so when reserves equal target it triggers resetting _BASE_TARGET_ and _QUOTE_TARGET_.
Invert first branch comparison to _BASE_RESERVE_ > _BASE_TARGET_, so correction happens only when base reserve exceeds target.
Remove the assignment to _BASE_TARGET_ in the first branch so only _RState_ and _QUOTE_TARGET_ are updated there.
Swap assignments in first branch to set _BASE_TARGET_ to _BASE_TARGET_ (no-op) instead of _BASE_RESERVE_, preventing update of _BASE_TARGET_.
